title: May, Must Not, Unless, Within, Breach, and Remedy are future syntax
rationale: These words are not in the implemented grammar. They are FUTURE_SPEC, not current features.
note: FUTURE_SPEC. Provided That is a guard, Shall is the effect, Otherwise Remedies is the fallback. Signatures are stored names only and are not authentication.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { x : Int = 0 }
Clauses
  Clause A(): Effect
    Provided That
      x == 0
    Shall
      Set { field: "x", value: 1 }
End
